description: Injecting a single unescaped quote character into a string-context parameter to see whether the backend database returns a syntax error, revealing unsanitized query construction.
detection_method: error_signatures.py matches a known DB engine error string in the response that was not present in the baseline response for the same endpoint.

description: A true-condition and a false-condition variant of the same numeric parameter are sent; the application's response differs (content, length, or status) based on query truth value, with no visible error.
detection_method: Requires paired baseline/test requests; response-comparison engine's text_similarity and length_delta between the true/false variants, both compared against a clean baseline.

description: A conditional time-delay function is injected into a parameter; if the response is measurably slower than baseline, the condition was evaluated by the database.
detection_method: comparison.py's timing_significant flag (elapsed_ms delta above threshold) is required but not sufficient alone -- must be corroborated by a second, independent delay-length test to rule out network jitter.

description: Appending a UNION SELECT clause with a probed column count to append attacker-chosen data into the result set returned to the application.
detection_method: Requires an incrementing column-count probe sequence and watches for a successful (non-error) response once the column count matches, then for marker data appearing in the rendered output.
